notes.title: Carebear knockoffs, Fungi, Fairies and Badass Sandworms! New Content Patch Live!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32518716/dc2e9f82968b84278ff4adc9c1419d084021fa2e.jpg

We released 4 new monsters:

The Carepanda, the fairy swarm, Portobellows and the mighty Wurm.
Alongside these new monsters, we released two new Soul Gear:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32518716/9d456f5a39570c15f45e6a55bed9e805e8a0a826.png

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32518716/2a577c5b65f05774af5fc6e6348bce3110f76ce8.png


---

Important Note:

In this update, we also fixed tons of bugs in the damage calculation. The order in which the bonuses were calculated was wrong. Instead of summing up, they were added on top of each other. Also, the Intelligence bonus was always meant to be 1% of increased elemental damage per point, but it was accidentally set to 3%.

The result is that units giving intelligence bonuses will be quite weaker. The ultimate result is that it will give more diversity to what constitutes a good build.

notes.title: Monsters dressed as Wizards, Superheroes, and Ninjas…0.0.20 out now!
notes.content:
We have tons of updates for you in Unreap Commander 0.0.20! Check the list below:


---

Artifacts / Loot Sets

New

The Wizard Set is perfect for monsters dealing elemental damage. The Superhero set is perfect for dealing physical damage and any monster that needs a buff to their max health.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32518716/9407af0a1efcb0b2960d2d8734cfe7ce79d41322.jpg

The Ninja set makes your units more nimble.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32518716/d1607aa9a948990a9fcc482800306dd5671c35ca.png

Updated

The Bullfighter set has had its armour debuff removed.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32518716/50c40422cccec8366fc24271b4edf5b9de2bf043.png

The Hockey set's bonus has been doubled.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32518716/b7cc350e62892f40c1b2853753f752967f43571b.png

The Elf set's bonus has been quadrupled.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32518716/214df41947cee0ad837ccac8f2d340d55db12ca2.png

---

Combat UI improvements

Speech bubble

The text in combat is now more readable and won't overlap anymore.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32518716/af1711eae1b4cfb52b8c8c2014b28874b5d14802.png

The previous panels were colourful and intrusive. We changed that.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32518716/4afab5467bb03cd5d1afe41bd3e7f0004af5d748.png

---

Quality of life improvements

When fusing, souls are now order by amount of exp you'll get from fusing:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32518716/8abd9ebf80cc2f7afb8a82020e7fe467cf959329.png

You can now search by the Soul's name:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32518716/47958559db0565d71712abf5453949522de8d774.png

Or choose a filter:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32518716/33b54f0332d8b860636ebd9d8503588811567388.png

And you can do the same for loot:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32518716/e51372b73a8879bcf08aa609d95eab3ad837b29d.png

And these work across the board (with one exception at the moment).

There's also a new Reapedia view:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32518716/f1f9aac3c536bd82b8e5a03119f82936079ef346.png

You can filter by Soul name in both views:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32518716/e9a95ab2e146bc7a81c2016b826c827129c1a236.png

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32518716/e11c25b6a21e79776e65ba8b41cbb3bd31c12c75.png

There are too many to mention here. But there were tons of tooltips causing issues before. We fixed most of them.

We also fixed the layer ordering of monsters in combat, which showed bigger monsters underneath other monsters when they should have been above.

notes.title: Unreap Commander 0.0.19 is Out! Balloons, Bushes, Vomit, Statues and Clowns — What a Motley Crew!
notes.content:
Daily Login Bonuses, New Monsters, New Soul Gear, and Tons of Bug Fixes
We wanted to release this new version on Friday, but you know, Halloween parties got in the way. Here’s myself and some buddies at an Halloween party in Medellin, Colombia:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32518716/3d7d2ef28f033bb2b1773482d54604c11b8fd538.jpg

That being said, we’re releasing now, just in time for our biggest sale ever on Steam: 35% off!

What can I expect from 0.0.19?
We aimed to add more multiplayer features but decided instead to focus more on fixing some glaring issues that either had been there for a while, or slipped in some of the recent builds.

Here’s what’s in this build:

Daily Login Bonus

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32518716/66c85a77d8878c95378c63f40319868467f6379d.png

Open the game every day to get a freebie, including the fabled Shamrock soul, legendary loot, and tons of misc. souls! The day resets on the GMT timezone.

5 new monsters

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32518716/6d8085977d1f0dc878a9b0744afbc4f7965d987c.jpg

Ratapow

Ratapow is an alternative to other monsters boosting Agility for the rest of the row or when equipped on loot. His main action reduces other monsters’ wind resistance. That ability was removed from Galewyrm and moved to this monster. That was done in an effort to balance the game a little better.

Yoker

Yoker is one of the strongest unit in the game (DPT-wise), dealing Dark damage to a full column. Put him in a row to make every unit regenerate a high amount of health on every hit.

Sundorak

Sundorak is a special monster. When slotted into loot, he increases the monster’s strength, intelligence, vitality and agility by 100! In the row, he boosts every unit’s light resistance by a very large amount (450% at level 200). His main action doesn’t do much damage, but it reduces all of a target’s resistances by 500%! He’s likely the game’s best de-buffer at the moment.

Vomitor

Vomitor deals high earth damage to lots of targets. In loot, it increases earth damage by a substantial amount.

Bushwacker

Bushwacker hides behind his bush and focuses on buffing his allies. Use him in the row or in loot to boost earth resistance. His main action renders earth attacks against your team almost useless.

4 new Soul Gear

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32518716/4f3a5b31b503f43c112471afd489b5e85d49c5cf.png

Blinded by is the only armor soul gear that boosts light damage. It’s extremely valuable to the Zookas and the new Sundorak. And with a lot of new Light monsters coming up, this is worth the investment of time to level up the Sundorak, Zookas and a Snow Rabbit!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32518716/606990d0f13db49da6099a6d081ae0bb49304df3.png

Burning Flash is probably the best soul gear for fire damage dealers. But because the damage is flat and not a bonus, it’s also a good way to add an extra element to any monster’s attack. The burn on turn effect is great for AOE actions. The intelligence boost is good for any elemental action.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32518716/ab62dfed60e9240d0a1c0b6fa8e26fbc7fb25fdd.png

Having a hard time against earth-based monsters? Try this soul gear. This almost renders any earth-based attacks worthless against you.

Bug Fixes and Rebalances


 Fixed bug where you could duplicate souls infinitely
 Fixed bug where units would act many times in a row. This was mostly seen using the Pirate set.
 Rebalanced buffer units so that they’re actually useful. A few versions ago, we changed the algorithm for elemental resistances making it so 100% resistance = taking 0.5x damage. 1000% = 0.1x damage. It used to be that 100% = taking 0 damage.
 Fixed issues with loot or soul inventory being full and breaking the UX. This is mostly a patch at the moment. Basically, if you having 300 loot or souls, you will stop receiving rewards. In a future version, we’ll allow you to manage the inventories so you can keep rewards post-limit.
 Fixed the Pirate set being over-powered. In addition to the fix mentioned above, we made it so the bonus doesn’t trigger 100% of the time. We put it down to 75%, which is still very useful.
 Rebalanced the Galewym so it’s not that much more powerful than other monsters.
 Increased most monsters’ health so they survive a little more.
 Fixed buffs and debuffs triggering on other monster’s turn. What you’ll noticed is a drop in usefulness of the poison and burn effects, as well as regen effects.
 Some UI fixes.


What’s coming up in 0.0.20?

0.0.19 is just out, but we’re already working on 0.0.20, one of the last few updates before we finally go in Beta!

The theme for 0.0.20 is: Online Features. We’ll toss in more bug fixes, rebalancing and new monsters into the mix!

Stay tuned!

Don’t miss out the 35% off sale from October 29th to November 5th!

Follow us

Instagram: http://www.instagram.com/powerlevelstudios/

Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/powerlevelstudios

Twitter: https://twitter.com/powerlvlstudios

notes.title: Unreap Commander 0.0.13 — The Update You’ve Been Waiting For
notes.content:
Unreap Commander 0.0.13 — The Update You’ve Been Waiting For
I’m not joking.

In this update, we’re bringing you the two most requested changes to the game:

1. Soul Reaper: Unreap Commander now supports all resolutions
We went from supporting only the 16:9 aspect ratio to all aspect ratios! This was, by far, the most requested change. We thought this would take us a month to do, but we worked really hard in the past week and managed to make it happen in only one week!

Here’s a screenshot at 5:4 aspect ratio:

https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/1600/1*qGgiaQn4sYEGzCQFp2cLZA.png

I wish I had taken a screenshot before we support it.

We also enabled the default Unity dialogue for choosing the resolution before starting the game, so the choice is yours:

https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/1600/1*kFl-ezQ_eSHcXlBiQVJ7yw.png

2. Soul Reaper: Unreap Commander has a much more usable User Experience

To start with, you need 3 clicks now to start combat. It used the take 6. Also, you can edit your selected squad directly from the main screen; greatly speeding up the process of equipping loot and powering up your monsters after combat.

Here’s a screenshot:

https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/1600/1*3oOpAuBD_ueL88I9G3BRyQ.png

Also, back buttons have been streamlined and are all in the top-right corner. The navigation at the top of the screen works more like a toggle now, making it so there’s no more overlapping of windows.

3. Soul Reaper: Unreap Commander has nicer UI

As you can see from some of the previous screenshots, we’ve cleaned up part of the UI as well. Going forward, there will be incremental changes in most of the new updates.

 What’s Next in 0.0.14?

The theme for 0.0.14 is:

Combat Improvements


    We’re going to make the row bonuses way more obvious;
    We’ll allow the player to select a target to start with;
    We’re going to make it more obvious that you can target specific monsters;
    We’ll add at least 5 new monsters; and most importantly
    Levelling your monsters up will unlock new powers for them. For example, a fire based attack may start applying a burn effect when the soul’s level is at level 50. Then it might start hitting multiple targets at level 100. And more.


We’re hoping we can bring these new changes to you by the end of next week. The foundation was put in place from the start to make this happen, so most of the difficulty is cranking up the content for each of the current souls in the game.

Conclusion

So check 0.0.13 out and tell us if it’s working in a resolution that didn’t work for you previously. Also let us know how you like the new UI and UX or if you’re noticing features that are gone that you thought were useful.

notes.title: An Unreapedia? Sounds Epic!
notes.content:
What’s New in 0.0.11?  

 1. The Unreapedia 
The Unreapedia is the “Pokedex” of Soul Reaper: Unreap Commander.

You can see your progress on your Soul Collection. It’s a nice way to figure out which Souls you have left to reap. But it also provides you with new ways to farm specific souls.

When you select an Unreap from the left, you see its details on the right, along with training options at the bottom. Clicking on the option selects the squad and goes back to the main screen so you can start combat from there.


 2. Pirate Ship (Name TBD) 
The Pirate Ship deals water damage to COLUMN targets.

Now, I know what you question is:

“Are the people/monsters controlling the ship like, super tiny?”

I have no clue. The point is, it’s a badass ship!


 3. Saving Settings 
Two settings are now saved properly:

- Mute/Unmute
- Combat speed

 4. 1 New Training Option 
 5. 6 New Feats and Steam Achievements

notes.title: Armed Bananas And Mini-Ghosts Holding A Bazooka? Hell Yeah!
notes.content:
What’s New in 0.0.10? 

 Leaderboards are now accessible from the main menu 

 New Leaderboards: Most Feats Completed 

 Better Tracking of Total Feats Progress 

 2 New Training Options 

 12 New Feats and Steam Achievements 

 Increased Level Cap to 200 

 Badnana 

Probably the most bad-ass banana you’ll ever meet!

Thanks to its surprisingly sturdy weapons, the Badnana hits hard, really hard…

But its actually quite squishy, so it dies easily…

 Zookas 

How these cute little creatures can lift such an imposing bazooka is a mystery to me.

Even stranger is the fact that I really have no idea what the real target is, the ghosts or the bazooka?

Nonetheless, swinging my scythe at them is fun as hell! Mwahaha!


See 
 here  for a more beautiful version of this annoucement.

notes.title: Steam Achievements are out in the latest version (0.0.9)!
notes.content:
Hi fellow Unreap Commanders!

We've just released 0.0.9, a very important update for you achievement lovers!

Here's what's new in 0.0.9:

 243 Achievements!
 5 new monsters
 30 new feats
 New Soul Reaper animations
 Minor UI updates
 Minor bug fixes


We're working on way more interesting achievements in future updates.

Also, big shout out to Team Griz for rocking the leaderboards.

0.0.10 will probably similar, with new achievements, monsters, feats, UI updates, bug fixes, and more loot diversity.

But please let us know in the forums what you'd like to see in 0.0.10 and beyond!

Random fact: I'm the "Shredder" team. Try to beat me! That new Hexawielder is a really cool new monster, based on TMNT and Gilgamesh (Final Fantasy V)!
